textRuns.value: Peaks over threshold: fixed 500 ha threshold, fires within 3 days merged into one episode, maximum likelihood, bootstrap by year blocks for the 95 % intervals. Return levels are in episodes: the size exceeded about once every N years. Observed level: the same, read straight from the 2016-2025 record. Reliable horizon: twice the observed period. A description of that record, not a forecast. Every table carries the MLflow run that produced it.
